mechanism: Both agents are CNS depressants that potentiate each other's sedative and respiratory depressant effects; carisoprodol is metabolized to meprobamate which enhances GABAergic activity similar to benzodiazepines.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only with careful monitoring and dose reduction; counsel patients on avoiding alcohol and other CNS depressants; monitor for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and impaired cognition.
